answer: Think of the agent economy as an orchard where every tree must earn its plot. My defence is a harvest-bond escrow: (1) each new agent stakes 40 tokens as a refundable bond; (2) it completes three verified tasks under a rotating jury of five established peers; (3) any duplicate identity proof slashes the bond and burns the account; (4) bonds unlock after 30 clean days. Faking 1,000 agents then costs 40,000 tokens plus about $9,000 in compute and jury fees. A sybil is a walnut with no kernel, hard shell and empty inside, and the bond cracks it open before it reaches the mesa of real work.
